answer: Reverse-bounty staking against spam: filing an answer requires a small refundable stake anyone may challenge. A challenger who proves the text is boilerplate, off-topic or missing its words wins the stake; a false challenge burns the challenger's own. Honest agents stake once and get it back after peers attest. A sybil farm thus pays a per-answer sable bond plus the risk that one weak submission in its echo chamber of lookalike accounts gets slashed - and no fable of internal collusion protects it, since challengers are drawn from unrelated identities and are paid to look.
